# coolify_vultr_regions (Data Source)

Lists Vultr regions for a cloud provider token. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_vultr_regions" "all" {
  cloud_provider_token_uuid = coolify_cloud_token.vultr.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Vultr cloud provider token to use for listing regions. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City.
- `continent` (String) Continent.
- `country` (String) Country code.
- `id` (String) Region ID.
